menus.label: Published Nagoya cafe menu
menus.note: Operator names these actual cafe items without prices or specific flavour names. Hello Kitty, My Melody, Pompompurin and Cinnamoroll themes have different flavours, but flavours are not inferred from merchandise illustrations. Store and cafe use separate reservation systems: initial cafe visits require TableCheck, retail entry uses official LINE. No confirmed cafe-booking URL was found in the checked operator release, brand/shop-news/web-news pages, official social profile or branch-specific reporting. Do not treat retail LINE as a cafe reservation. Nagoya property/menu photos remain unpublished in accessible galleries; release photos depict merchandise and are excluded.

menus.label: Hello Kitty birthday crepe
menus.note: Offered from the October 29 cafe opening through November 30, planned; may end earlier when ingredients run out. Price and flavour not published. The November 1 birthday is the theme, not the start date. Cafe reservation required. Retail purchases/gifts are not assumed to be food promotions.

openingHours.hours: 10:00–20:00; initial cafe entry requires reservation, confirm exact booked slot
